<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/README.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对

**L1 first review · ACCEPT** · head `88e8fdcc415725f3dfa1878c1a85cad0e291f4d0` · card #33700 · read 2026-11-17T01:31Z

### Checklist (read on GitHub at this head, not from the report)

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, attribution header, then `Fixes #33700`. Closing-keyword scan of the whole body: one hit, `#33700`. `Fixes` agrees with the card's Target ("the Console sends `$count=false` where it does not show a total, **and/or** the door answers a cheaper total"): the first arm is delivered and the area's ruling on the card (6933630606, option A) leaves the exact count where a total is printed. L1 agrees that A needs no maintainer decision: it adds no contract and changes nothing visible, and a capped total would be a new contract card if anyone asks for it.
- **File surface:** 17 files from `get_files`, inside claim 6930990327 and its amendment in 6933630606 (the adapter, `@object-ui/types`, the adapter README, the bench `_nocount` legs, `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx`) plus the call sites and their pins. Server code is untouched: `count=false` is the declared opt-out the list door already honours.
- **Adapter, read in the source:** `find()` routes a read to `rawFindWithPopulate` only on an explicit `$count === false` (absent and `true` keep the SDK route, as the `$expand` / `$search` arms already do), and the raw GET sets `count=false` only then. `normalizeQueryResult` leaves `total` absent only when the caller declined it; every other read keeps `total ?? count ?? records.length` as before, so no surface that prints a total sees a change. No non-test `ui/**` file on `main` sent `$count: false` before this PR, so no existing caller changes behaviour by the routing.
- **Call sites:** the repeater and record picker set `$count: false` only beside a `$top`; the timeline sets it on its paged read. None of the three reads `total` (`git grep` at this head). The surfaces that print a total are not touched.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/33700-list-count-opt-out.md`, patch on `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-timeline` (all published); the bench lives in the unpublished `packages/qa`. Sentences checked: "`ObjectStackAdapter.find()` now honours `$count: false` … the result carries no `total`. The page length is not used in its place. An absent `$count`, or `$count: true`, still gets the total" (the two adapter hunks); the call-site and "Surfaces that print a total keep it" sentences (the diff touches only the three named renderers). It cites no timing.
- **Docs:** `data-objectstack.mdx` and the README row say the same as the adapter; "`hasMore` is still answered from the page" holds (server `hasMore` first, else the page-length estimate, unchanged).
- **Tests and controls:** `countOptOut.test.ts` pins `count=false` on the plain and the expand route with no `total`, and the absent / `true` controls; the record picker, repeater (with an unpaged control) and both timeline registrations are pinned. The exact-shape pins that changed are named in the body. Ablations: the record picker line and the adapter routing arm each turn their pin red.
- **Measurement:** the bench gains a `NAME_nocount` twin for every paged GET scenario; the body's PG / SQLite table is a local reading of that leg on a shared box, and states the SQL shape (page statement identical with and without the opt-out). The readings are this PR's own bench leg, now reviewed here; they are not in the changeset.
- **Gates at this head:** check-runs on `88e8fdcc…`: 67 runs, 56 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 0 failed (`Check Changeset` was re-running after a body edit when I started and finished `success`). `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and all 16 `Test UI` shards `success`.

### Out of scope, for the area to place (one line each: `filed #N` or `dropped — reason`)

- "Observation, not filed": a member's count path re-reads `sys_record_share` and `sys_queue` for the read scope the page read already resolved (two extra statements per paged list).
- "Observation, not filed": on SQLite the admin's 50-row page costs about 135 ms of database time with no count.

### Owed after this

- **L2:** not owed. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no `(narrowing)`, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path.
- **Landing tier:** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34540`: 0 of 17 paths governed, 264 changed lines (+251 / −13) ≤ 3000 ⇒ ordinary queue landing by the area, on this head.
